content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment refers to a seamless system that links payment processing and product delivery directly, eliminating the middleman. When a customer makes a purchase using cryptocurrency, the infrastructure automatically verifies the payment and delivers the ebook without further action needed from the seller. This method is essential for creators in regions where traditional payment processors impose steep fees or are completely unavailable. By adopting this architecture, creators can retain a larger portion of their earnings, enhancing their overall revenue potential significantly.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of this automated delivery system consists of several key components. First, a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments handles the transaction, ensuring that the payment is confirmed on-chain at a very low fee of just 0.5%. Once payment confirmation occurs, either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script triggers the automated delivery of the ebook. The ebook itself is stored in a secure cloud location, such as Google Drive, ensuring instant access for customers. This architecture creates a resilient and efficient ecosystem that operates independently of traditional financial systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in emerging markets who sell products like ebooks, courses, and templates but encounter barriers when using conventional payment systems. It empowers creators in countries such as Zimbabwe and Venezuela to monetize their expertise without relying on restrictive platforms that have high transaction fees. By adopting this infrastructure, creators can focus on production and marketing rather than navigating payment hurdles, making it a crucial tool for sustainable digital commerce in financially isolated environments.
Automated delivery keeps your customers satisfied with instant access to purchases.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The automated ebook delivery system encompasses several components working in unison. The first is a hosting solution such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a platform for the online store. Next, the backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to process orders and handle delivery seamlessly. Order storage is managed using Supabase or Google Sheets, which allows easy access and management of transactions. Finally, NOWPayments facilitates the payment processing, making it easy for customers to pay with various cryptocurrencies, ensuring a comprehensive digital commerce solution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement an automated ebook delivery system, start by selecting a hosting provider like GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Integrate the NOWPayments service for crypto payments and configure your product storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Once everything is in place, upload your ebooks and test the entire flow by simulating a purchase. For a more comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which provides all necessary blueprints and templates for building your stack.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize crypto payment processors like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies while automating the delivery of your ebooks. By leveraging tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can create a seamless transaction and delivery system that operates independently of conventional platforms.
NOWPayments reduces fees to just 0.5%, significantly boosting your bottom line.

Start by choosing a hosting provider, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders. Integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for transaction and inventory management. Upload your ebooks and configure automated delivery. Finally, test the entire purchase flow to ensure everything works smoothly.
